_note: Provenance for the retained third-party artifacts in this directory. Every file is kept BYTE-VERBATIM as retrieved; nothing in this repository rewrites, reformats, or normalizes them. Failure mode this record guards against: a silently re-fetched or hand-edited copy would still cross-check cleanly against itself, so the cross-check would report agreement while proving nothing.
